source: A real capture (2026-10-29, RyzenShine): the K2 HE (3434:0e20) on its USB cable, charging, through its own raw HID node (hidraw17; hidraw16 is its keyboard/mouse interface). It sent nothing by itself in 5 s; each 0xA4 request (report id 0, then 32 bytes) was answered within about 2 ms, with transport 0x04 (it stays linked to its dongle on the cable) and charging 1. The answers went 81, 82, 82, 82, 82 %; the first is kept. A Launcher request (0xA0) got its own answer.
